planets.name: Kepler-1649 c
planets.description: Transiting planet of Kepler-1649 with a 19.5-day year, found in 2020.

text.card: Kepler-1649 c was found in 2020 by Kepler as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 2 planets known around Kepler-1649. Its orbit and size follow Vanderburg et al. 2020's fit, the archive's default.
text.locator: NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table, default parameter set (pl_refname VANDERBURG_ET_AL__2020): disc_year 2020, disc_facility Kepler, sy_pnum 2; pl_orbper 19.53527, pl_radj 0.09456687, pl_bmassj 0.00377

quotes.title: Kepler-1649c
quotes.card: Kepler-1649c is an Earth-sized exoplanet, likely rocky, orbiting within the habitable zone of the red dwarf star Kepler-1649, the outermost planet of the planetary system discovered by Kepler’s space telescope.
quotes.introduction: It is located about 301 light-years (92 pc) away from Earth, in the constellation of Cygnus.
